name: Chilaquiles Rojos
summary: Oven-crisped tortilla wedges tossed in red sauce and topped with fried eggs, cheese, and sour cream.

ingredients.name: yellow onion (half for the sauce, half diced for topping)

instructions: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Cut each tortilla into 6 wedges, toss with 2 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt, and bake on two sheets 12–15 minutes until crisp.
Meanwhile, finely chop half the onion and cook it with the garlic in a large pan for 3 minutes. Add the spices, crushed tomatoes, and broth and simmer 8 minutes.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil in another pan.
Add the tortilla chips to the sauce and toss for 1 minute. They should soften at the edges but keep some crunch.
Divide between plates and top each with two eggs, cheese, sour cream, and diced onion. Serve right away.

glutenFree.notes: Corn tortillas are naturally gluten-free, but a few brands add wheat flour. Check the label. Check the broth label too.

budgetNotes: Substitution: cheddar replaces queso fresco, which isn't reliably stocked at Ottawa chain stores. The taste changes: queso fresco is mild, milky and slightly salty, and crumbles without melting. Cheddar is sharper and melts into strings. If you find queso fresco or feta, crumble it on at the end instead.
Stale tortillas work better than fresh. This is a dish for using them up.
Store-bought tortilla chips save time but cost more, about $4 for a bag.
Toss the chips in the sauce right before serving or they go soggy.
